$comment: 3form's own CMS (no framework; server-rendered <walter-block>/<miles-block>/... custom elements whose content attribute is rendered by JavaScript, with a div.crawler-copy fallback that holds the product name in an h2 and the intro in the next p). Product pages are /products/<slug>. There is no price and no stock signal anywhere: every CTA is 'Request a Quote' (or a dealer/rep contact), so price is not configured and every product returns price.state 'unknown' with a PRICE_MISSING warning. The product gallery is also client-rendered, so the only server-side image is og:image in <head> and root is the whole document, anchored on the product h2. Specs come from the same div.crawler-copy fallback, which lists the specification sections as h3 headings each followed by sibling p/div values (no row element), so specs use the siblings layout. The 'Product Details' h3 is a section heading with no value and is skipped; the Downloads links (spec sheet PDF, CAD/Revit/install files) are excluded so that section is skipped too. /gallery/<id> pages are inspiration articles (og:type=article, no product fields) and do not match. Checked against five saved (curl) product pages on 2026-11-12.
